verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents a built-in CI/CD tool, Bitbucket Pipelines, for automated workflows on hosted or private runners, so the core CI/CD capability is first-party. The evidence never states that pipelines are defined as code in a repository file, or that they trigger automatically on pushes and pull requests. missing for 10: documentation of pipeline-as-code config stored in the repo, documented automatic triggers on push and PR events, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define CI/CD pipelines as code in my repository and have them run automatically on pushes and pull requests

citations.quote: Use our built-in CI/CD tool, Bitbucket Pipelines, to create powerful, automated workflows.
Run CI/CD workflows across your organization using hosted or private runners—or both, with centralized visibility across pipeline status
